# PLAN — iteration 4
## Current state assessment

The incumbent is timing-feasible at WNS 1.387 ns and WHS 0.109 ns. Iterations 2 and 3 did not improve it: narrowing the products and using carry-save partial sums both failed the objective. The current seed separates each product wire from its registered accumulation, so the next trial can target DSP multiply-accumulate inference while preserving the known one-cycle top latency.

## Hypothesis

Fusing each product and its corresponding accumulation into one signed multiply-add expression may map the arithmetic more efficiently into DSP48E1 resources and improve register-to-register setup slack beyond the incumbent.

## Instruction for generator

In `fir8`, remove the standalone `p0`–`p7` product wires and write each existing `acc` and `y_out` next-state expression as a signed product-plus-accumulator expression, keeping the current tap-to-accumulator mapping and register boundaries. Preserve 32-bit modular result behavior, all coefficient parameters, synchronous reset clearing, and `// @latency 1`; do not add pipeline stages. This is a distinct trial from iteration 2’s product-width narrowing alone; retain it only if all verification gates pass and routed register-to-register WNS strictly exceeds 1.387 ns while full WNS and WHS remain nonnegative.
